blocks.text: DENVER — Nikola Jokic reiterated his pledge to sign a long-term extension with the Denver Nuggets next summer. Only this time, he added a caveat. “If they want me,” the three-time NBA MVP cracked Monday at media day. The decision to hold off on a new deal makes financial sense, but it has created angst among the fan base. By waiting until next summer, Jokic can sign a five-year supermax contract that would be worth in the vicinity of $350 million. By waiting until next summer, though, there’s always that chance he could exit should the team struggle. READ: Nikola Jokic […]...
